instruction_loading.mechanism: Repository AGENTS.md hierarchy; local product/system constraints remain higher priority.

git.mechanism: Local Git subject to sandbox and repository policy.

secure_github.mechanism: Connected GitHub app, OAuth, or environment-managed credential; never prompt storage.

persistent_storage.mechanism: Git repositories and approved machine-local state.

background_scheduling.mechanism: External automation or deterministic OS scheduler; a chat session is not continuous.

cross_prompt_activation.mechanism: External scheduler, automation, or new user task.

inbox_events.mechanism: Explicit task-boundary polling or external event source.

secret_storage.mechanism: Provider/OS secret store outside source and prompts.

deployment_boundary.mechanism: Profile adoption does not deploy services.
